data.one_liner: A Dart code generator to create fully typed OperationRequests for the ferry GraphQL client.
data.what_it_does: Generates fully typed operation requests and data types to be used with the ferry GraphQL client based on your GraphQL documents and schema.
use_when: You are building a Flutter or Dart application using the ferry GraphQL client
You want compile-time type safety for your GraphQL operations and responses
avoid_when: You are not using GraphQL in your project
You prefer runtime-based or dynamic GraphQL queries without code generation
strengths: Provides fully typed data structures for GraphQL queries, mutations, and subscriptions
Integrates smoothly with build_runner and the broader gql-dart ecosystem
weaknesses: Requires running a code generator whenever GraphQL schemas or queries change
Adds multiple generated boilerplate dependencies to your project
data.setup_notes: Requires adding build_runner and configuring build.yaml to generate types alongside your source files.
